title: an anonymous action retains its receiver only when its body reads it
purpose: Observe control flow and call semantics.

stdout.text:
destroyed adder
made 42 reader
destroyed reader

provenance.expected_basis: OkkamaBook 18.5: unreferenced values are not retained; a reference to self retains the receiver. The adder action never reads self, so its temporary receiver is destroyed when the statement ends; the reader action reads a field and keeps its receiver until main ends.
